stories.title: Batam data center expansion threatens water and electricity supplies
stories.summary: Rapid data center expansion on Indonesia's Batam island is raising concerns over strain on local water and electricity supplies, according to The Jakarta Post. The growth, fueled partly by spillover from Singapore's constrained market, is testing the island's utility infrastructure.
stories.why_it_matters: Batam has been positioned as the primary overflow market for Singapore-facing capacity, and utility constraints could slow that pipeline or shift demand to Johor and other alternatives. Operators and investors with Batam exposure face rising permitting and infrastructure risk, while Indonesian authorities will be pressured to align power and water planning with data center commitments.
stories.title_zh: 巴淡岛数据中心扩张威胁当地水电供应
stories.summary_zh: 据《The Jakarta Post》报道，印度尼西亚巴淡岛（Batam）数据中心的快速扩张正引发对当地水电供应承压的担忧。这一增长部分得益于新加坡受限市场的外溢需求，正在考验该岛的公用事业基础设施。
stories.why_zh: Batam已被定位为承接Singapore需求的primary溢出市场，而公用事业（utility）方面的约束可能放缓这一pipeline，或将需求转移至Johor及其他替代市场。在Batam有敞口的运营商和投资者面临日益上升的许可审批和基础设施风险，同时印尼当局将承受压力，需要将电力和水资源规划与data center承诺保持一致。

stories.title: GDS Holdings rises 7.6% after raising 2026 guidance on AI-driven data center demand
stories.summary: GDS Holdings' shares rose 7.6% after the Chinese data center operator raised its 2026 guidance, citing stronger-than-expected demand driven by AI workloads. The upgraded outlook reflects accelerating orders for capacity from cloud and AI customers across its markets.
stories.why_it_matters: The guidance raise signals that AI-driven demand in China and APAC is translating into actual bookings rather than just pipeline talk, resetting expectations for regional operators' growth rates. Investors, competitors and hyperscale customers will read this as evidence that capacity absorption in the region is tightening, which could influence pricing and expansion plans.

stories.title: Nvidia scales back funding guarantee for Ohio OpenAI data center, WSJ reports
stories.summary: Nvidia has scaled back a funding guarantee tied to an OpenAI data center project in Ohio, the Wall Street Journal reported. The move reduces Nvidia's financial backstop for the AI infrastructure build-out.
stories.why_it_matters: The pullback suggests growing caution among AI hardware suppliers about underwriting end-customer infrastructure, tightening the financing conditions around large AI data center projects. For the broader market including APAC, it signals that the credit support underpinning the AI build-out boom may be less reliable than assumed, affecting how developers structure deals and raise capital.
stories.content:
By **Reuters**

Branding for Nvidia at the Nebius AI UK data center, a new facility hosting Nvidia and other computer firms, at Ark Data Centres, in Chertsey, Britain, Nov. 6, 2025 / Reuters-Yonhap

Nvidia has revised its plans to support a proposed OpenAI data center project in Ohio and is now expected to initially guarantee less than $120 billion, down from the $250 billion previously discussed, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.

The Journal said Nvidia and OpenAI are nearing an agreement, with the chipmaker expected to provide a financial backstop only for the first phase of the project. A deal could be signed as early as this weekend, according to the report.

The change was made after investors raised concerns about Nvidia's risk exposure tied to large financing commitments, the newspaper said.

This came after Nvidia on Monday partnered with six major financial institutions to launch compute financing platforms aimed at raising over $500 billion in third-party capital for AI infrastructure.

OpenAI is still discussing a binding lease for the full 10-gigawatt project in Ohio, WSJ said. The site is being developed by SB Energy, a subsidiary of SoftBank, and would be the largest data center project announced to date if completed.

Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment outside regular business hours. OpenAI declined to comment.

The project would help OpenAI move toward owning AI infrastructure, although its ability to fund large-scale commitments remains under scrutiny because the company is unprofitable despite a valuation of $852 billion.
stories.title_zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，Nvidia缩减对俄亥俄州OpenAI数据中心的资金担保
stories.summary_zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，Nvidia已缩减与OpenAI俄亥俄州数据中心项目相关的资金担保。此举降低了Nvidia对这一AI基础设施建设的财务兜底力度。
stories.why_zh: 这一回撤表明，AI硬件供应商在为终端客户的基础设施提供担保方面日益谨慎，大型AI data center项目周边的融资条件正在收紧。对于包括APAC在内的更广泛市场而言，这释放出信号：支撑AI建设热潮的信用支持可能不如此前设想的那样可靠，这将影响开发商构建交易和筹集资本的方式。
